transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the weekly sustainment review. Before I sign the disposition plan for the holding area, I need confirmed updates from each of you on the materials awaiting disposition — used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders. Environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, and transportation reps: please report your latest status on each category so I can record it in the review record and release material for pickup or return.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I confirmed this morning that the used oil consists of exactly 18 drums accepted by the contracted recycling service, with pickup available on 26 June. The contractor confirmation is in the environmental file but has not yet been added to the S-4 disposition worksheet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, for the vehicle batteries: I counted exactly 24 cases. The approved battery vendor requires no more than 12 cases per pallet, so the shipment must use exactly two pallets with battery-hazard labels. The count and packing instruction are in the motor-pool inspection folder but have not yet been sent to logistics.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, for the expired medical cold packs: I confirmed they must be returned to Medical Supply rather than discarded locally. The return appointment is set for 25 June and is on the clinic supply calendar, but it has not yet been cross-referenced with the holding-area disposition plan.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Ma'am, for the empty compressed-air cylinders: I confirmed that the carrier will accept them only on 28 June and requires them to be secured upright in a cylinder rack during loading. The carrier's acceptance note was received after my last transportation update and has not yet been added to the movement worksheet.
transcript.speaker: A5
